bits.name: MIA_STAT_ERRORS
bits.description: Error queue contains at least one error.

bits.name: MIA_STAT_CMD_RUNNING
bits.description: Command handler is executing queued commands.

bits.name: MIA_STAT_DMA_RUNNING
bits.description: MIA RAM DMA copy is in progress.

bits.name: MIA_STAT_SPEED_CHANGING
bits.description: A PHI2 speed change has been requested and not yet applied.

bits.name: MIA_STAT_VIDEO_FRAME_REQUESTED
bits.description: Video client update request accepted; ACK not received yet.

bits.name: MIA_STAT_VIDEO_FRAME_SENT
bits.description: Initial video response send finished; ACK may still be pending.

bits.name: MIA_STAT_EXEC_PAUSED
bits.description: PHI2 is stopped by the exec pause control.

bits.name: MIA_STAT_SD_PRESENT
bits.description: SD card initialized successfully. This is not a physical socket-detect bit.
